title: barista config.json
description: barista settings; used at user level (~/.barista/config.json) and workspace level (<workspace>/.barista/config.json), workspace overrides user

parallel.description: Max concurrent repo operations; overridden by --parallel

color.description: Color output mode; NO_COLOR env var takes precedence over everything

colorProfile.description: Color depth when color is enabled; auto = detect from terminal, other values force truecolor/256/16-color output

download.mirror.description: Global download mirror preset for JDK/Maven/Gradle/Node.js binary downloads; only affects binary downloads — version metadata and checksums always come from official sources. Overridden per domain by jdk/maven/gradle/node.download.mirror

jdk.download.mirror.description: Download mirror preset for JDK binary downloads; applies to temurin only (microsoft/corretto/zulu/graalvm always use official sources). Overrides download.mirror; only affects binary downloads — metadata and checksums always come from official sources

maven.download.mirror.description: Download mirror for Maven binary downloads: a preset name or a custom https:// base URL mirroring the Apache dist tree. Overrides download.mirror; only affects binary downloads — version metadata and the sha512 checksum always come from official sources

gradle.download.mirror.description: Download mirror for Gradle binary downloads: a preset name or a custom https:// base URL mirroring services.gradle.org/distributions. Overrides download.mirror; only affects binary downloads — /versions/all metadata and the sha256 checksum always come from official sources

node.download.mirror.description: Download mirror for Node.js binary downloads: a preset name or a custom https:// base URL mirroring the nodejs.org dist layout. Overrides download.mirror; only affects binary downloads — index.json metadata and SHASUMS256.txt checksums always come from official sources
